entities.name: Humoral hypercalcemia of malignancy
observations: Severe hypercalcemia with suppressed PTH is compatible with PTHrP-mediated humoral hypercalcemia of malignancy.
Pulmonary squamous-cell carcinoma is a leading tumor setting for PTHrP-mediated humoral hypercalcemia.

entities.name: PTH-related protein
observations: PTHrP production by lung squamous-cell carcinoma can cause severe hypercalcemia, suppressed PTH, and hypophosphatemia.
PTHrP-mediated hypercalcemia is rare in small-cell lung cancer and exceptional in adenocarcinoma or other histologies.

entities.name: Squamous-cell carcinoma of lung
observations: Most likely explanation for a central lung mass, heavy smoking history, and PTH-independent severe hypercalcemia due to PTHrP-mediated HHM.
Squamous-cell carcinoma commonly presents centrally and has a stronger HHM association than small-cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, or large-cell carcinoma.
